newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIA STOCKS CONTINUE FOREIGN FUND-DRIVEN RISE.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIA STOCKS CONTINUE FOREIGN FUND-DRIVEN RISE.

text.p: Colombian stocks continued their strong upward trend in a day of trading dominated by demand for bank and beer stocks, dealers said.

Bogota's IBB price index gained 2.15 percent to 1,312.08 on above average trading volume of nearly 6.4 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED .IBMG general price index rose 1.52 percent to 19,498.91 on volume of 4.5 billion pesos.
Dealers said feverish demand by foreign funds caught on among local investors, creating a rush on the local markets.
